_meta.note: Findings are machine-extracted statistical associations. variable_1 and variable_2 are an association pair, not a guaranteed exposure-then-outcome order. Only items with source_checked=true were compared against the paper by a human-supervised review; everything else is reported by the graph and unverified. Publication dates come from PubMed, not from the graph. For the 10 K540E papers the graph has read, findings_from_k540e_papers lists what it extracted; use study_id with GET /v1/studies/{id}/associations for the live list.

coverage.note: Counted against the CSV snapshot. No graph finding names K540E by itself; three name the quintuple or sextuple haplotype that contains it.

example_live_calls.study_associations: GET /v1/studies/{study_id}/associations?limit=50&include_total=true — what the graph extracts from one of the 10 K540E papers
example_live_calls.by_pubmed: GET /v1/studies?filter=pubmed_id:33684211 — check whether the graph has read a paper (372 candidate PubMed IDs are in k540e-literature.json)
example_live_calls.k540e_variable: GET /v1/variables?search=name:K540E — probe whether any variable now names the mutation
example_live_calls.confirm_finding: GET /v1/associations/489sn1mPQa — live check of one displayed finding

known_gaps.reason: Searched the full associations CSV snapshot for variables containing 540, dhps, dihydropteroate, sulfadoxine, pyrimethamine, IPTp, chemoprevention and related terms. The closest the graph holds are the two Tanzania birth-weight findings on the dhfr/dhps sextuple haplotype and one Ethiopia finding on the dhfr triple mutant.

excluded_after_source_check.reason: Reversed comparison. In the paper, relative risk 0.32 is dihydroartemisinin-piperaquine IPTp compared against sulfadoxine-pyrimethamine IPTp; the graph presents it as an effect of SP. The id is in the vetted list but was removed from stakes_sp after checking against the paper.
